notes: Corrected: the to before Hazar addar was on the verb under rule 44; it belongs to the directional accusative under rule 33, which rule 44 itself defers to for an adverbial accusative.
The variant unit WLC.NUM.34.4.v001 is underdetermined and its base reading is compatible with the ASV; s016 and s017 are aligned as ordinary source text (rule 9).
The two mi-negev phrases are each one fused rendering southward, headed on the noun (rules 30, 40); the governed noun keeps no English of its own in either.
